raw.title: Key Account Manager
raw.excerpt: The National Restaurant Association and National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation are proud to be part of a highly respected industry, providing hospitality, opportunity, and quality of life.
raw.description:
The National Restaurant Association and National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation are proud to be part of a highly respected industry, providing hospitality, opportunity, and quality of life. Much like the industry we represent, we have a dynamic, diverse, and inclusive culture, grounded in trust, hospitality, collaboration, and innovation. These are the core values that inspire our work, and what we are looking for in a Key Account Manager to expertly represent and drive sales strategies for our industry leading training and certification products.

The learning products offered by the National Restaurant Association, and its family of brands ServSafe, ServSuccess, National Registry of Food Safety Professionals, and American Hotel and Lodging Educational Institute, has led the way in training and certifying millions of current and future hospitality workers. We provide best-in-class food safety, risk mitigation, career development and leadership training to restauranteurs, hoteliers, food service businesses, retail operations and academic institutions across the world. We equip our global audience with innovative, engaging training utilizing multiple platforms, from textbooks to online resources, courses to mobile applications, with a focus on both compliance-driven and career-development suites.

As the Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for a portfolio of high-profile national accounts across restaurant chains with 150+ locations, developing and executing sales strategies, plans, and initiatives in support of our industry risk mitigation product lines. The role collaborates directly with corporate contacts, while supporting and navigating franchise communities to assist with program adoption and growth.

Ideal candidates bring a customer-centric, consultative sales approach with a proven track record of successfully building and sustaining long-term relationships across all levels of client accounts. Must bring experience navigating lengthy and complex sales cycles, strong command of Salesforce and highly effective time management and organizational skills, as well as experience managing multilocation customers and/or large geography.

Prior experience in strategic selling of SAAS, training, certification or e-learning products within the restaurant, retail, training market, or related fields is highly desirable. Position requires the presence, polish, and presentation skills to engage Director, VP, and C-Level executives and influence key business decisions.

This is an individual contributor role that can operate fully remote within the United States (within a company-approved territory) with approximately 25% travel anticipated for key account visits, tradeshows, and other industry events. Compensation includes a competitive base salary plus a variable sales incentive, structured at 80% base and 20% performance-based earnings.

We are proud to offer our team members comprehensive benefits, designed to support their financial, professional, and personal well-being. In addition to outstanding healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), competitive salaries, generous vacation and leave time, we offer a matching 401(k) plan, a unique collection of corporate discounts and memberships, as well as programs to support career and skills development, including learning and tuition assistance, and so much more.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive revenue growth by executing sales strategies, achieving product penetration goals, and expanding business within assigned accounts.
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline through prospecting, lead generation, and active participation in industry events.
  • Develop and maintain relationships across all levels of customer organizations, using a consultative approach to identify needs and deliver solutions.
  • Create and execute account and territory plans, including forecasting, pipeline management, and performance tracking against targets.
  • Increase account value by driving product adoption, optimizing pricing, and maximizing profitability through effective negotiation and contract management.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally and with customers to implement programs, solve problems, and support long-term account success.
  • Maintain accurate sales activity, pipeline, and account data in CRM systems and leverage tools for lead development.
  • Monitor industry trends and provide insights to inform sales strategy, product positioning, and organizational improvements.
  • Communicate effectively with leadership and stakeholders on sales performance, opportunities, and market dynamics.
  • Manage contract compliance, revenue collection, and travel budgets to support overall business objectives.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred in any major and/or combination of experience.
  • A minimum of 7+ years of experience with demonstrated skills in strategic selling of SAAS, training, certification and e-learning products within the restaurant, retail, training market or related fields.
  • Excellent prospecting and sales experience with a continuous learning mindset.
  • Previous experience leveraging sales database or Salesforce.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goal for consecutive years.
  • Excellent presentation skills to key stakeholders from business owners, HR executives, Training and Development Directors, C-suite executives, and other decision makers or influencers.
  • Strong familiarity with technology used to deliver e-learning, including use of high-level technical acumen (SSO, API, web services, etc.).
  • Ability to understand and sell products effectively for multiple brands.
  • Demonstrated capacity to develop and build relationships, effectively and persuasively present and demonstrate products, negotiate, and close, and cultivate partnerships and alliances to drive sales and overall business.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and to work independently; a self-initiator, versatile and assumes risk with responsibility.
  • Strong organizational, time management, priority-setting and problem-solving skills, plus project management and business planning.
  • Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Thoughtful interpersonal and diplomacy skills; ability to interact and communicate effectively at all levels of organization.
  • Mastery of Microsoft Office programs, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Ability to learn other software programs as needed and enter and maintain accurate data/information.
  • Possess strong work ethic and high degree of integrity.
  • Highly adaptable; ability to work well under pressure, within fast-paced and fluid environment.
  • Capable strategic vision in areas of business, sales, and the hospitality industry, with sound decision making abilities.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

The National Restaurant Association, National Restaurant Association Solutions, LLC, and The National Restaurant Association Educational Foundation (together, “Company”) is committed to equal employment opportunity, and it is Company's policy to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

It is our policy to recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job titles, and ensure that all other personnel actions are administered, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status and disability, or other legally protected status, and we will ensure that all employment decisions are based only on valid job requirements.

This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.

For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

raw.description:
The Company

At Canopy Growth, our mission is clear: improve lives, end cannabis prohibition, and strengthen communities. We believe that cannabis can be a force for good. We’re building a consumer-centric organization that is focused on sharing the transformational potential of cannabis with the world. We will achieve this through an innovative and disruptive portfolio of cannabis and hemp-derived products.

Canopy Growth is the world's leading cannabis and hemp company. We recognize that employees are at the core of our success, and we take pride in a corporate culture that emphasizes inclusiveness, collaboration, and diversity.

Our employees come from a wide range of backgrounds, each bringing their own unique skills and talents to the table, working together to continue our incredible momentum of growth. If you are interested in building global challenger brands, scaling a business, and working in a values-driven environment, we want to hear from you!

The Opportunity

The Director of Strategic Execution plays a critical leadership role in translating Canopy’s strategy into results. This individual acts as a central force in ensuring that the company’s strategic priorities are clearly defined, rigorously executed, and consistently delivered across the organization.

Working directly with the SVP, Supply Chain & Transformation and in close partnership with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), this leader will drive enterprise-wide strategic initiatives, establish disciplined execution practices, and embed a high-performance operating rhythm across the business. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, transformation, and execution—someone equally comfortable shaping direction and driving accountability to outcomes.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Strategy Execution

  • Partner with the ELT to operationalize Canopy’s 3-year strategic plan, ensuring clear alignment between strategy, priorities, and execution

  • Translate enterprise strategy into actionable initiatives, with defined scopes, milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes

  • Establish and lead a centralized view of all strategic initiatives, ensuring prioritization, resource alignment, and delivery against commitments

  • Drive clarity, focus, and accountability across initiatives to ensure tangible business impact and value realization

Strategic Initiatives & Program Leadership

  • Lead a portfolio of cross-functional, enterprise-level strategic initiatives from ideation through execution and value capture

  • Mobilize and lead cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment across business units and functions

  • Identify risks, remove barriers, and proactively course-correct initiatives to maintain momentum

  • Ensure consistent use of best-practice program management and structured problem-solving methodologies

Transformation Leadership

  • Support end-to-end transformation initiatives, including operating model redesign, cost optimization, supply chain improvements, and organizational effectiveness

  • Act as a catalyst for change, helping the organization accelerate decision-making and execution despite competing operational pressures

  • Partner with business leaders to embed new ways of working and ensure sustained adoption of changes

  • Support corporate development initiatives, including integration planning and execution for M&A activities

Operating Model & Performance Management

  • Design and institutionalize a best-in-class strategic execution framework, including governance, decision rights, and execution cadence

  • Develop and implement performance management systems (KPIs, dashboards, operating reviews) to track progress against strategic priorities

  • Support a rigorous operating rhythm (e.g., MBRs, initiative reviews, executive updates) to drive transparency and accountability

  • Elevate performance across sites and functions by introducing structured continuous improvement and problem-solving practices

Experience

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree; MBA, Masters, PhD, etc. a desirable bonus

  • 6–9 years of experience in management consulting, internal transformation, strategy, or operational excellence roles

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives through to execution

  • Strong structuring, problem-solving, and communication skills

  • Ability to operate comfortably between executive leadership and operational teams

  • Experience in operations-heavy, regulated, or manufacturing environments

  • Prior exposure to large-scale transformation, integration, or performance improvement programs

  • Experience building or implementing operating models, KPIs, or governance structures

Other Details

This is a full time remote position based in Ontario.

Salary Range: $150,000 - $175,000

Benefits – extended health and dental coverage, paid vacation, and participation in our employer-supported retirement savings program

We appreciate your interest, and promise to review all applications, but we will only be contacting those who best fit the requirements.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require accommodation, please notify your Talent Acquisition Partner. Please note, the chosen applicant will be required to successfully complete background and reference checks.

Recruitment Process: All applications for this role are reviewed manually; no AI-based screening or ranking tools are used.

This post is for an existing vacancy.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for a Payments Operations Specialist to support the end-to-end student payment lifecycle, including payment processing, loan operations, documentation management, refund handling, and cross-functional coordination, while ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and an excellent student experience.

What you will do

  • Manage and process student payments, ensuring accuracy across payment schedules, billing records, and partner systems.
  • Support loan operations by reviewing eligibility requirements, coordinating documentation, and maintaining accurate records throughout the approval process.
  • Maintain and validate payment data, reconcile transactions, and monitor enrollments to ensure data integrity across systems.
  • Process and manage student documentation, including enrollment agreements, academic records, and other operational documents.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve payment-related inquiries, refunds, documentation requests, and operational issues.
  • Handle payment operations workflows, including payment plan adjustments, program transfers, payment link generation, and issue resolution.
  • Calculate, process, and communicate student refunds in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Monitor recurring payment plans, proactively identifying and addressing payment issues to support a positive student experience.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of operational processes, documentation, and team workflows.

Please note: The Payments Operations Team manages several operational streams. In this role, you will focus on a specific area while collaborating closely with the broader team.

Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience in an operational role within an IT, SaaS, EdTech, or other technology-driven environment.
  • Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas (e.g. XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH), data validation, reporting, and working with large datasets.
  • Experience working with operational systems such as billing platforms, CRM tools, help desk systems, or data management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues, identify root causes, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy when working with financial, operational, and student-related data.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and time-management skills.
  • Comfort working with routine operational tasks while continuously identifying opportunities to improve processes and increase efficiency.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and incomplete information.
  • Proactive mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience using collaboration and documentation tools such as Slack, Notion, or similar platforms.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across different teams and functions.
  • Interest in technology, online education, and digital products.
  • Experience building or documenting operational processes is a plus.
  • Familiarity with automation tools and workflow optimization is a plus.

What we can offer you

  • Full-time remote collaboration;
  • Compensation for part-time collaboration is 600 USD per month.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools— Miro, Notion, Google Meet, etc.— to make the process of working together seamless.
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself.
  • Diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across Israel, Serbia, USA, Georgia, Armenia and more.

raw.description:
GenLogs is a hardware, software, and data company building the next generation of Truck Intelligence™. Our mission is to build unbreakable supply chains in order to make our world safer and stronger. Through a nationwide network of sensors, we help our customers source carriers, eliminate fraud and theft, and provide real-time visibility on every truck in America. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a highly organized, execution-focused Digital Marketing Manager to own and optimize GenLogs' digital marketing operations. This role will be responsible for executing and managing digital campaigns, social media programs, website updates, email marketing, paid advertising, SEO/AEO initiatives, content development, and content publishing efforts.

This is an ideal opportunity for a marketer who enjoys turning strategy into action, thrives in a fast-paced startup environment, and wants to help build a scalable marketing engine from the ground up. We're looking for someone who can not only execute campaigns but also create compelling content and leverage AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and amplify impact.

Reporting to the Director of Marketing, this role will work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Leadership to support company growth initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Execute and manage integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels
  • Own day-to-day social media management, publishing, and performance optimization
  • Manage paid advertising campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, and other relevant platforms
  • Maintain and optimize the GenLogs website, including landing pages and conversion paths
  • Lead SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives to drive organic growth
  • Build, deploy, and optimize email marketing campaigns, newsletters, and nurture programs
  • Own content creation and publishing efforts, including blogs, customer stories, case studies, thought leadership, webinar content, website copy, and campaign assets
  • Translate complex industry and product concepts into clear, compelling content for target audiences
  • Develop and maintain an editorial calendar aligned with company priorities and demand generation goals
  • Support webinar, event, product launch, and demand generation campaigns
  • Create and manage landing pages, forms, and campaign workflows
  • Leverage AI tools and emerging technologies to improve content creation, campaign execution, workflow automation, research, personalization, and team productivity
  • Experiment with AI-enabled marketing approaches and identify opportunities to scale impact efficiently
  • Track, analyze, and report on marketing performance, campaign results, and key KPIs
  • Identify opportunities to improve website traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversion rates
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Leadership to support growth initiatives
  • Help build scalable marketing processes, systems, and best practices as GenLogs continues to grow

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, content marketing, or a related field
  • Strong writing and content development skills, with experience creating a variety of content formats including blogs, social posts, customer stories, landing pages, and campaign content
  • Hands-on experience managing social media, email marketing, paid advertising, and website content
  • Strong understanding of SEO best practices and emerging Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and workflows and an ability to apply them meaningfully to increase marketing effectiveness and productivity
  • Proficiency with marketing technology platforms, analytics tools, content management systems, and AI-assisted workflows
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze performance and translate insights into action
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to working across teams

BONUS

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, logistics, transportation, supply chain, or high-growth startup environments
  • Experience using AI-powered tools for content generation, workflow automation, analytics, research, or campaign optimization

WHO WILL SUCCEED HERE

  • Curious and proactive, with a desire to understand customers, markets, and what drives results
  • Strong owners who enjoy taking ideas from concept through execution without waiting for perfect direction
  • AI-native and adaptable, naturally incorporating new tools and technologies to improve efficiency and outcomes
  • Creative and analytical, balancing compelling storytelling with a focus on performance and measurement
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by fast-moving environments where priorities evolve quickly
  • Collaborative and motivated by partnering across teams to drive meaningful business impact

BENEFITS

  • Employer-covered comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for employee and dependents

  • Flexible leave for caregiving and medical needs

  • Budget availability for approved professional development courses, certifications, and training

  • 100% travel reimbursement for all approved company travel and spending

raw.title: AI Enablement Director | LATAM
raw.excerpt: Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators.
raw.description:
Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $100m in revenue and is the leading specialized storage cloud - managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We are seeking an AI Enablement Director!

About the Role:

Backblaze is executing an ambitious, company-wide AI transformation program that is fundamentally reshaping how our organization operates at scale. This is not a theoretical research project - it is a live, high-impact initiative with production deployments already in production. We are driven by a commitment to operational excellence and tangible results, and this role sits at the very center of that mission. You will be responsible for shaping the path forward, ensuring that our AI initiatives deliver clear, measurable value that drives the business forward. This role sits at the center of it.

Reporting to the CHRO, you will lead the AI use case lifecycle, managing everything from initial intake to final production. Your responsibilities include scoping complex workflows, architecting innovative solutions, overseeing pilot programs, and precisely measuring the impact of these changes. Partnering closely with functional directors, you will identify high-potential areas for AI integration and process transformation, ensuring these initiatives translate into tangible operational results.

The program has a simple test: by Q3, we should be able to answer "what has AI actually delivered this year?" in a single slide with numbers. You are the person who makes that slide possible.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the use case pipeline. Triage incoming requests, refine problem statements, size value, and maintain a prioritized queue across functions. Lead each use case through discovery, scoping, pilot, and launch - coordinating functional owners, IT, Engineering, Legal, and Finance as required.
  • Do the workflow work. Conduct structured current-state assessments with department teams. Map how work actually happens today. Find where volume, repetition, or research intensity make AI a strong fit - and surface the use cases that would never appear in a top-down scan.
  • Design the right solution. Evaluate whether a given workflow calls for an off-the-shelf tool, a prompt layer, a vendor product, or a custom build. Engage Engineering and IT when integration or custom development is required. Document baselines before launch. Measure the delta after.
  • Govern the tool stack. Own the AI vendor evaluation process end-to-end: fit assessment, security and privacy review, pilots, and build-vs-buy recommendations. Maintain the AI Tool Registry with zero ungoverned deployments. Track spend per team monthly with cost-per-outcome visibility available to the executive team.
  • Keep leadership informed. Maintain a live view of every active use case, its status, its owner, and its impact. Produce outcomes reports. Surface role and change implications early - before they become problems.

The Right Fit:

  • 7+ years in program management, business operations, or automation delivery - with direct experience moving AI or workflow automation initiatives from discovery to production
  • Hands-on fluency across the modern AI stack: prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, LLM orchestration, tool evaluation, and governance
  • Experience conducting workflow assessments with business stakeholders - not just technically, but operationally: mapping current states, identifying leverage points, designing future states
  • A track record of producing outcomes framed in time saved, cost reduced, or revenue impacted - not features shipped or tools deployed
  • Clear written communication: business cases, executive updates, solution design documents

Nice to Have:

  • Experience running an AI program across multiple functions simultaneously
  • Familiarity with AI governance in data-sensitive or PII-adjacent environments
  • Background in cloud infrastructure, storage, or technical B2B businesses
  • Exposure to org transitions - restructures, outsourcing programs, distributed team ramp-ups - and the workflow documentation challenges they create

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
Libertex Group Overview

Established in 1997, the Libertex Group is an international powerhouse with over 28 years of financial markets expertise.

Over the years, the Libertex Group has helped shape the online trading industry by merging together innovative technology, market movements and digital trends. This was made possible with the introduction of ‘Libertex’, the multi-awarded online trading platform with which anyone can access the market and invest in stocks or trade CFDs with underlying assets being commodities, Forex, ETFs, cryptocurrencies, and others.

A firm believer in the power of sports to inspire, empower and push for success, Libertex is the Official Online Trading Partner of Audi Revolut F1 Team.

The Libertex Group in Numbers:

• 28+ years of fintech experience

• 3M+ clients worldwide

• 700+ employees

• 45+ international awards (for Libertex)
• 300+ tradable assets (through Libertex)

The Libertex Group is constantly driven by a single passionate purpose – to tirelessly work on developing amazing fintech for people who simply want to have ‘more’ in their lives.

Job Overview

Libertex Group is looking for a performance ads designer to join our one-of-a-kind in-house creative studio. We have an international team consisting of creative professionals with different talents and backgrounds. Now we are looking to add one more static designer to this awesome group of people. The Designer will be responsible for creating banners strictly used in user-acquisition/performance campaigns (SM channels) and adapting them to various formats and styles in line with our corporate brand guides.

What Will You Do?

  • Produce banners for performance campaigns in social media channels;
  • Work on routine tasks such as localization, batch-production and exporting;
  • Work closely with the creative director and the art director. Collaborate on a daily basis with the social media manager;
  • Take active part in the creation of concepts and visual assets for ad campaigns;
  • Create work for high-profile brands from the online trading and crypto industry;

Requirements

Requirements:

  • 1-3 years of experience in graphic design or equivalent
  • Proficient use of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) and Figma
  • Strong working knowledge of AI tools across the creative pipeline - LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) for ideation and copy, image generation tools (Midjourney, Nano Banana, etc.), and AI video tools (Kling, Seedance, Veo, etc.) - with the ability to chain them together, generating a still image and then turning it into a simple animated/video creative
  • Solid understanding of the digital marketing ecosystem (SM / SEM / Google Display / App Stores, etc.)
  • English language - fluent
  • Proven creative background with a strong portfolio
  • Ability to quickly juggle multiple projects of different magnitudes and deadlines
  • A proactive approach, evaluating creative trends and always on the lookout for the next best-converting banner
  • Experience producing Facebook/Meta ads for complex niche industries (e.g. finance or crypto), where testing dozens/hundreds of creatives is required to find what converts best
  • Technical know-how of Meta, TikTok, and Instagram ad specs and formats
  • Good understanding of metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, ROAS
  • Comfort with short-form video editing and motion basics for ad creatives (e.g. CapCut, After Effects basics)
  • Experience in batch production (tools like Bannersnack, Creatopy, or similar)

Additional Skills (not obligatory):

  • 3D software knowledge (Blender, Maya, etc.)
  • Creative agency background (or a similarly versatile environment)
  • Good understanding of Google Sheets/Docs and Zoom
  • Knowledge of Jira or similar project management tools
  • Previous trading/finance industry experience

Benefits

We offer

  • Work in a fun and friendly environment
  • Competitive salary available in euro / crypto
  • Quarterly Bonus based on Company Performance
  • 21 working days of annual leave plus public holidays
  • Udemy for Business Unlimited Membership and Language training courses
  • The opportunity to excel in your professional career

Please send your CV in English, your portfolio and showreel along with the application.

Libertex Group is an equal opportunity employer, fostering an inclusive and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on any characteristic protected by the law. Candidate privacy is respected, and all data is securely stored and used solely for recruitment purposes, in line with GDPR and our internal policies. Unsuccessful applicants may have their data retained for future opportunities unless deletion is requested.

Application (CV & portfolio) in ENGLISH is a must.

Please note: All official communication regarding this position will come only from email addresses at edconnective.com, edconnective.io, or through our JazzHR platform. Any other domains (careers-edconnective.com) or contacts are not affiliated with EdConnective and may be fraudulent.

Why this role matters

As a Professional Learning Community (PLC) Facilitator at EdConnective, you’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring educators get the support they need to thrive—and that students benefit from stronger instruction. We are looking for a team member to guide educator development by facilitating highly effective PLCs of teachers, instructional staff, and/or K-12 leaders.

This is a part-time, hourly remote (work from home) position. Hours will vary based on project needs.

Who we are

At EdConnective, we believe the most powerful tool in any classroom is the educator. Our mission is to ensure every student thrives by supporting exceptional teacher and leader growth. When educators grow, students win—and our work accelerates that growth every day. If that excites you, you’re in the right place. We are in search of experienced educators and K-12 leaders with the ability to facilitate efficient and effective PLC meetings, communicate actionable strategies for growth with participants, and build positive rapport with partner schools and districts.

Why you’ll love EdConnective:

  • Real Impact, Every Day – Your work will directly improve outcomes for educators and students. Our inboxes are full of stories showing just how transformational this support can be.

  • No Gimmicks, Just Great Work – Our customer approach is consultative, thoughtful, and high-integrity. No pressure tactics. No spammy follow-ups.

  • Elite Team, Shared Mission – You’ll collaborate with leaders and mentors who’ve helped to build iconic education organizations (Rosetta Stone, EverFi, and others) and you’ll work alongside expert coaches with thousands of years of combined experience.

  • Smart Tools, Less Busywork – We use modern tech to automate the tedious and amplify the strategic.

About Us:

Datacor is the leading provider of software solutions, including ERP, CRM, Asset Tracking, Simulation and Formulation, to the process manufacturing space. We are on a mission to better equip the industry with software solutions and move it forward by building thoughtful, intuitive products that solve our customers’ most difficult problems.

We are passionate about serving our customers and helping them use data as a competitive advantage. Our customers make products that extend and sustain lives by sanitizing, fertilizing, beautifying, cleaning, and recycling the world we live in. We at Datacor help our customers make those products you use every day more safely, cost effectively and more efficiently through our technology platforms and applications.

The Role:

As an Implementation Specialist, you will play a critical role in the successful delivery and adoption of Datacor software solutions. You will work directly with customers and internal Delivery Managers to configure, test, train, troubleshoot, and support customers through implementation and go-live.

This is a remote position that requires periodic travel to customer sites. The ideal candidate brings 3–5 years of real-world ERP experience—either as an end user, an implementer, or both—and thrives in a customer-facing, problem-solving environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide implementation services related to the installation, configuration, testing, training, and go-live support of Datacor ERP software at customer sites and remotely.
  • Work closely with Delivery Managers to execute project plans, meet milestones, and ensure smooth customer experience throughout the implementation lifecycle.
  • Meet with customers to analyze business processes and consult on best practices, system configuration, and process optimization using Datacor software.
  • Deliver end-user and administrator training, including system navigation, workflows, and day-to-day operational use.
  • Troubleshoot configuration, process, and data-related issues, providing timely resolution and clear communication to customers.
  • Support customers during cutover and go-live, including hypercare support as needed to ensure successful adoption.
  • Develop and maintain training documentation, user guides, and internal knowledge base materials to support continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to methodology improvements by sharing implementation insights, lessons learned, and best practices with the broader delivery team.
  • Manage multiple tasks and customer engagements simultaneously while completing administrative responsibilities such as time entry, status updates, and recap documentation accurately and on time.

Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of real-world ERP experience, either: as an ERP user, and/or as an ERP implementation consultant.
  • Experience with Datacor ERP is highly desired but not required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, accounting, finance, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Strong understanding of business processes in areas such as accounting, operations, inventory, manufacturing, or distribution.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Proven ability to manage time effectively and work independently in a remote environment.
  • Comfortable working directly with customers in a consultative, service-oriented role.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts and databases, including basic SQL concepts, is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

Why Join Datacor:

  • Work with a collaborative delivery team supporting impactful, real-world manufacturing solutions.
  • Gain exposure to complex ERP implementations across diverse industries.
  • Grow your ERP expertise while helping customers succeed from implementation through go-live and beyond.

EOE Statement:

Datacor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis or race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
dein profil

Du willst Banaut werden, hast aber keine passende Stellenausschreibung gefunden? Kein Problem! Wir suchen laufend Werkstudenten und Praktikanten. Du kannst auch deine Abschlussarbeit bei uns schreiben. Wir finden den richtigen Platz für dich!

wir bieten

Wir halten nichts von Floskeln wie “immer frisches Obst” und “flache Hierarchien”. Wir täuschen keine super edgy Firmenkultur zur Rechtfertigung von schlechten Arbeitsbedingungen vor. Wir haben das schlechte Image von Agenturarbeit satt und sind der lebende Beweis, dass es in der Branche auch anders laufen kann.   

 

  • Herausforderung: Wir arbeiten für internationale Konzerne, traditionsreichen Mittelstand oder frisch geschlüpfte Start-ups. An spannenden Projekten mangelt es nicht.   
  • Flexibilität: Bei uns hast du ein Arbeitszeitkonto und genießt einen Überstundenausgleich, du entscheidest dich für Freizeit oder Auszahlung. Außerdem sind wir offen gegenüber aller Art von Teilzeitmodellen (50 %, 80 %, etc.), falls du keine 40 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten möchtest. Und für noch mehr Flexibilität bieten wir dir eine Sabbatical Möglichkeit nach mind. einem Jahr bei uns. 
  • Office oder Remote: Falls es zwischen uns passt, hast du die Möglichkeit, 100 % Remote zu arbeiten. Workation im Süden gegen den Winterblues? Bei uns kein Problem. Achja, unser Büro in Stuttgart Mitte ist auch nicht schlecht.   
  • Fairness: Von einem “Dankeschön” kannst du dir nichts kaufen. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine überdurchschnittliche Vergütung, angepasst an deine Erfahrung und Leistung.   
  • Kultur: Mit einem Durchschnittsalter von unter 30 Jahren bestehen wir ausschließlich aus Digital Natives. Digitaler Spirit statt angestaubte Firmenkultur. 
  • Benefits: Wir fördern grüne Mobilität und bezahlen dir dein Deutschlandticket oder bezuschussen das Leasing für ein Fahrrad oder einen E-Roller. Außerdem bezuschussen wir deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Frisches Obst und kalte Drinks gibt es natürlich auch. 
  • Respekt: Statt Hire & Fire hast du bei uns einen krisensicheren Job mit unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag. Wir sind eine der wenigen Agenturen, die während der Pandemie eingestellt statt entlassen hat.   
  • Aber auch sonst ist bei uns einiges geboten: regelmäßige Events im Rahmen unserer Banauten & Friends Reihe und eine jährliche Workation mit dem ganzen Team (zum Beispiel auf einem großen Anwesen in Italien). Darüber hinaus hast du ein persönliches Fortbildungsbudget zur Förderung deiner persönlichen Entwicklung.

raw.description:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

We are the creators of Pyroscope, an open-source continuous profiling database that offers rapid, scalable, highly reliable, and efficient storage and querying capabilities. It aids in gaining a comprehensive insight into resource utilization within applications, right down to the specific line of code. The project seamlessly integrates with Grafana, enabling users to correlate profiling data with metrics, logs, and traces, and leverage profiles as a crucial component of application observability. Our dedicated backend development team works closely with clients and the Grafana Cloud teams to deliver profiling solutions for on-premises and cloud environments at scale.

In our expansive domain, some of the projects we have undertaken include:

  • Implementing distributed systems to effectively manage profile ingestion and queries.
  • Establishing instrumentation support for various programming languages including Golang, Dotnet, Java, Ruby, eBPF, Python, Node.js, and Rust.
  • Built & Enhanced the functionality of the Pyroscope plugins to provide users with an intuitive interface for exploring and analyzing application profiles.

This position focuses on implementing distributed systems to effectively manage profile ingestion and queries.

Pyroscope is trusted by leading multinational companies for essential applications and infrastructure. We prioritize innovation and inclusivity, empowering every team member to share ideas that improve our product as a dependable solution.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Collaborate with your team to deliver new features, analyze outcomes, and make improvements
  • Lead projects from concept to implementation, including ongoing customer support
  • Design, build, operate, and maintain essential systems, ensuring reliability, performance, and availability
  • Take an active role in influencing our roadmap and your own career objectives
  • Participate in on-call rotations and take responsibility for the services you oversee
  • Support and mentor team members, engage in design conversations, and work closely with colleagues
  • Expand your skill set by deepening your knowledge of our cloud products, understanding our customers, and learning about our codebase
  • As we have embraced a remote-first approach and our engineering team is primarily remote, it is essential to possess strong communication skills and the ability to work independently. We provide support and hold regular meetings through video calls to ensure effective collaboration and alignment.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro).

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You are a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action
  • We build everything with our users in mind.
  • You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • Pragmatism: You are able to take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve short feedback loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback and then progress iteratively
  • Collaboration and communication: The smallest unit we have is a team. You’ll be working with your teammates in a fully remote setup. Good communication skills are a must
  • Solid experience with at least one programming language. We use Go, but if you have familiarity with Python, C, C++, Rust or similar, then that translates well
  • Some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, brainstorming ideas all the way to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way
  • Strong experience with designing and developing software that runs in the Cloud or experience with systems engineering
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others.
  • Experience with being on-call and performing operations/SRE tasks or with the concept of infrastructure as code
  • Solid experience with distributed systems
  • Experience working with Kubernetes

Bonus Points For:

  • Been a user of Grafana and Prometheus in operational roles (including on-call for your team at a previous employer or just using these tools on hobby/homelab projects)
  • Exposure to microservices architecture
  • Databases backend experience

In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $154,445 - $185,334 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

We're looking for the right person to build that foundation from the ground up.
This is a hands-on leadership role with real ownership: you'll shape how data is collected, structured, and delivered — and grow a team around you as the function matures.

WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

  • Design the target-state data architecture: Postgres CDC → Kafka → Snowflake → client-facing data products.
  • Own tooling decisions across ingestion, orchestration, transformation, and quality layers.
  • Implement CDC-based ingestion from PostgreSQL services (RDS, Aurora, EC2, K8s operator) using Debezium or equivalent.
  • Build streaming and near-real-time pipelines with defined SLAs.
  • Build a data quality control layer: checksums, reconciliation, schema validation, anomaly detection, and alerting.
  • Define quality checkpoints across the full pipeline — from source capture through Snowflake to client delivery.
  • Define and enforce data contracts with service-owning teams for core entities: transaction, merchant, settlement, and processing status.
  • Build the external data delivery layer: financial settlement, transaction status, processor reconciliation, and client analytics.
  • Design tenant separation and implement replay/reload mechanisms for failure recovery.
  • Start hands-on, then gradually hire and grow a small data engineering team as the function matures.
    Build a pragmatic roadmap with concrete deliverables at 3, 6, and 12 months.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

  • 5+ years in data engineering with end-to-end ownership of production pipelines.
  • Hands-on with Snowflake, PostgreSQL CDC (Debezium preferred), and Kafka.
  • Solid AWS experience — S3, RDS, Aurora, and cloud data infrastructure.
  • Data quality engineering mindset: monitoring, reconciliation, lineage.
  • Comfortable defining data contracts and driving requirements with backend engineering teams.
  • Technical leadership experience: project ownership, cross-team alignment, delivery under constraints.
  • Kubernetes, Airflow/Prefect/Dagster, and dbt are strong pluses.
  • Payments domain knowledge — settlement, transaction lifecycle, processor integrations — is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with gRPC, RabbitMQ, and reading Go/Python service code is expected.
  • English language skills at the B2 level and fluent russian language.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • An opportunity to make something great even greater, you can be the reason why we grow, develop, and become the best fintech company on the market!
  • Career prospects - we are young, we have huge ambitions, and it is important that our employees grow with us
  • Work with coworkers who are passionate about their business
  • Compensation that will fully correspond to the competence and knowledge, with yearly performance reviews
  • Remote work

JOB SUMMARY

The Assistant Director of Group Health is responsible for the overall client satisfaction and growth of Dane Street’s Group Health Division.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure delivery of key client metrics including Turnaround Time (TAT), Quality (measured by clarification %), P2P success, overturn rate, and any other key performance metrics set forth by our Group Health customers.
  • Lead the Operations Management Team and oversee all activities directly related to the operational procedures.
  • Attract, recruit, and retain Team members.
  • Work with the Group Health Operations Teams on internal and external quality audits and make recommendations on process improvements/updates.
  • Recommend development initiatives to help enhance the usage of technology for client satisfaction and internal efficiencies.
  • Responsible for the reconciliation of client outcomes reports & issue logs.
  • Responsible for the overall Profit and Loss of the Group Health Division.
  • Work with the National Medical Director on the development and management of the physician panel.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

A Bachelor’s or Graduate’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Minimum 5-10 years experience managing a team of Utilization Management (UM) Nurses at a Health plan or IRO.

RN (preferably BSN or higher)

Experience working with Utilization Management standards and guidelines

Experience leading an operational unit/division, ensuring customer service goals are met, and achieving profitability, goals and objectives.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

Who you are

•Professional Experience:* Proven professional experience in IT Project Management.*

  • Remote Work: Fully flexible freelance setup.

This role requires an engineer obsessed with user experience and dedicated to delivering a top-tier product.

Speed, execution capability, and the aptitude to design elegant solutions will position this individual as a foundational pillar of the engineering team. The organization aims to revolutionize the financial technology industry and establish a new paradigm, requiring exceptional technical minds to achieve this vision.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Technical Proficiency: Proven ability to craft exceptional iOS applications using Swift, Xcode, and Instruments.
  • Deployment Experience: Demonstrated experience shipping applications to the App Store, with a strong understanding of App Store Review processes and guidelines.
  • Architecture & Methodology: A solid grasp of state-of-the-art iOS architectures and agile development methodologies.
  • Testing Standards: Experience utilizing unit and snapshot testing to ensure clean, testable, and reliable code.
  • Engineering Mentality: The ability to develop, debug, test, and deploy complex Swift projects independently while maintaining a collaborative, team-first attitude.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience building visually stunning iOS Swift applications.
  • Precision: An exceptional eye for detail with a pixel-perfect focus on UI/UX implementation.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary plus high-upside stock options
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive private dental and health insurance.
  • Tooling: Provision of top-tier hardware and technology required for the role.
  • Time Off: 30 days of paid annual leave (excluding bank holidays).
  • Flexibility: Complete geographic flexibility—the choice to work 100% remotely or from the local office.
  • Global Mobility: The option to work from abroad for up to 4 months per calendar year.

Interview Process

The hiring organization utilizes a streamlined evaluation process designed to respect the candidate's time:

  1. Initial Alignment (Optional): To maximize efficiency, the process typically bypasses an initial hiring manager screening to move directly to the practical evaluation. However, an introductory call can be readily arranged upon candidate request.
  2. Take-Home Technical Assessment: A practical exercise designed to showcase coding standards and architectural approaches.
  3. Technical Interview & Review: A session with the mobile engineering team consisting of a general technical Q&A and a collaborative review of the take-home assessment.
  4. Behavioral Interview: A final conversation focused on team alignment, core values, and collaborative culture.

Get started on an exciting career at Element!

Element employees make a difference in the lives of others every day. We are re-defining the fleet management industry to be people first, then business – delivering on our promise of a superior client experience. This takes hard work and innovation, and we need more like-minded people on our team.

About the Role

We’re looking for a client-centric individual to join our team as a Relationship Manager. In this role, you will play a key role in developing and maintaining effective relationships with existing customers within their portfolio to ensure Element wins repeat business and maintains and grows revenue by executing on: proactive client renewals (RFPs), pricing optimization, and share of wallet opportunities.

This position is a critical component of achieving growth objectives, relationship retention, and building consistently superior client experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain effective relationships within an existing customer portfolio to ensure, sustain, and grow existing revenue, win repeat business, and achieve growth targets by executing on proactive client renewals (RFPs), pricing optimization, and share of wallet opportunities
  • Be in continuous outreach and/or active discussions with existing clients in order to uncover requirements through Know Your Client strategies. Develop creative solutions to help meet customer needs, goals, and objectives. Articulate Element’s value proposition and suite of products and services, manage/overcome objections and address outstanding client escalations, questions, and concerns
  • Develop client strategies to achieve revenue growth and client retention in collaboration with Operational Teams
  • Maintain, nurture, and expand services offered to clients within assigned portfolio of existing clients
  • Consistently maintain operating discipline measured in SFDC (i.e. Coverage Metrics, Forecasting, Relationship Plans, Risk Assessments, Opportunity Creation, maintenance, client + pricing overviews, etc.)
  • Lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams to engage with the client to execute against Customer Engagement Plans (Strategic Consulting, Client Success, Ordering, etc.) to meet client objectives
  • Travel may be required for this role as there is an expectation of maintaining a high level of client contact and participation

Basic Qualifications

· BA/BS degree or equivalent

  • 5 years of experience in a strategic relationship management or related position
  • Experience working in Salesforce or other CRM
  • Accountable for the management of existing client portfolio for Element Fleet, generally Fortune 500 or multinational organizations
  • Must possess strong sensitivity to customer’s need and an ability to identify pain points and turn them into opportunities
  • Resourceful with the ability to navigate within a large organization to achieve client and corporate initiatives
  • Accountable for revenue growth of assigned existing client portfolio including proactive client renewals, pricing optimization, share of wallet, and maintaining current revenue within portfolio
  • A solid understanding of leasing, rates, terms, financing alternatives, billing, vehicle expense drivers, and the proven ability to service and sell to all levels within a client’s organization

Preferred Qualifications

· MBA

  • Experience within the fleet/vehicle management or a related industry

Location: US Remote with preference for candidates in Maryland

The hiring base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $132,000 annually. Actual compensation within this range will be dependent upon the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, equity with other team members, and alignment with market data. Please note that the disclosed salary range is solely for candidates hired to perform work within this geographic location. Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location.

What’s in it for You
• A culture of innovation, empowerment, decision-making, and accountability
• Comprehensive health and welfare benefits that serve the needs of you and your family and foster a culture of wellness
• Additional benefits and amenities, including paid time-off programs (vacation, sick leave, and holidays)

Applicants will be required to undergo a background check only if and after a conditional offer of employment has been extended.

Element Fleet Management and its wholly owned subsidiaries are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Should you require an accommodation with our hiring process please send an email to talentacquisition@elementcorp.com or call (800) 665-9744. Job Description

Account Executive - Ireland Accounts

Are you a driven sales professional who thrives on building meaningful client relationships and delivering tailored solutions?

Do you want to be part of a team that is transforming how legal and business professionals access and use critical information?

About our Team

LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,800 employees worldwide, is part of RELX (http://www.relx.com), a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers. Our company has been a long-time leader in deploying AI and advanced technologies to the legal market to improve productivity and transform the overall business and practice of law, deploying ethical and powerful generative AI solutions with a flexible, multi-model approach that prioritizes using the best model from today’s top model creators for each individual legal use case. The company employs over 2,000 technologists, data scientists, and experts to develop, test, and validate solutions in line with RELX Responsible AI Principles.

About the Role

In this role, you will take ownership of driving new business growth across the Irish legal market, proactively engaging with law firms and in-house legal teams to understand their business challenges and identify how LexisNexis solutions can support them. You will deliver tailored, consultative sales across legal, tax and business research products, helping customers achieve better outcomes. This is a dynamic opportunity to build and develop relationships across the Republic of Ireland, win new business, and contribute directly to revenue growth in a strategically important market.

Responsibilities

  • Formulate account strategies to maximize new revenue opportunities and win profitable business
  • Achieve sales and productivity targets on a weekly, monthly, and annual basis
  • Manage customer accounts to ensure timely debt resolution
  • Prepare and execute sales strategies for allocated territory, maintaining accurate forecasts and pipeline
  • Deliver regular sales reports and forecasts to the Head of Business Development
  • Develop new relationships with decision-makers and influencers
  • Prioritise opportunities to maximise customer-facing time, achieving a minimum of 6 client meetings per week
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure an integrated approach to customer care

Requirements

  • Experience building and maintaining strong client relationships, ideally across Ireland (this role will focus solely on Irish Market)
  • Proven success in a fast-paced, target-driven sales environment
  • Demonstrated ability in solution-based, consultative selling
  • Strong communication skills with sound business acumen
  • Ability to manage multiple complex opportunities simultaneously
  • A proactive, resilient approach with curiosity and integrity
  • Experience using structured sales processes and best practices
  • Track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets

Work in a Way That Works for You

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis® and Nexis® services.

TBIPS Category: A.1
Quantity: 7 Resources
Contract Period: ASAP – March 2029 (+ 1-year option to 2030)
Location: REMOTE
Security Clearance Required: SECRET
Estimated Days: 220 days per resource (initial period)

About the Engagement

Seven Application/Software Architects (Software Developers) will form the core delivery team for the three TC marine safety digital products. Working in an Agile SDLC environment, resources will design, develop, test, and maintain complex software solutions, including API integrations, front-end components, database platforms, and CI/CD pipeline configurations. All development must align with GoC Digital Standards and Treasury Board policies.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery & Collaboration
  • Collaborate with the Agile Development Team to deploy, customize, and integrate computer systems using Agile SDLC or Design Thinking methodologies
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies: daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
  • Deliver incremental software enhancements at the end of each sprint
  • Participate in team retrospectives to assess and improve current processes, tools, collaboration, and communication
  • Share knowledge via code reviews, pair programming, and internal documentation
Requirements Analysis & Architecture
  • Conduct business and technical requirements analysis to determine system and solution needs
  • Gather stakeholder input, define objectives, and identify the technology stack and system architecture
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze requirements, review designs, and assess technical feasibility
  • Participate in user requirements, architectural design, troubleshooting, and prototyping sessions with the Product Owner and development team
Application Development
  • Analyze, design, develop, modify, test, troubleshoot, and maintain highly complex software solutions using technologies including: VB.NET, C#, Azure SQL Server, Power BI, SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server SSIS, and Azure Data Factory
  • Implement authentication, authorization, APIs, and third-party integrations ensuring security and maintainability
  • Develop front-end components using HTML/CSS/JavaScript; implement server-side logic, APIs, and database integration
  • Optimize application performance, security, and maintainability while adhering to best practices
  • Conduct code and design reviews; ensure compliance with coding standards and perform necessary refactoring
  • Link pull requests to DevOps work items for traceability
Testing & Quality Assurance
  • Conduct unit, integration, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate functionality, reliability, and performance
  • Fix bugs and refine features based on stakeholder feedback
  • Conduct code and design reviews ensuring compliance with GoC coding standards
  • Create automated test scripts for regression testing (e.g., Selenium, Playwright)
  • Assist in technical audits to assess overall software quality and performance
Deployment & DevOps
  • Configure deployment pipelines (CI/CD); set up staging and production environments
  • Manage deployment processes; establish rollback and recovery procedures to ensure system stability post-deployment
  • Create deployment scripts and automated deployment tools
  • Recommend, schedule, and perform software improvements and upgrades across multiple environments
Documentation & Knowledge Transfer
  • Develop and update technical documentation including API documentation, system architecture diagrams, and user manuals
  • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions and produce training materials for internal TC teams
  • Coach and mentor team members to enhance their technical expertise and understanding of the codebase
Deliverables include: Business and technical requirements documentation, user stories and acceptance criteria, system architecture diagrams, developed and tested application code (VB.NET, C#, SQL, Azure Data Factory), functional APIs and third-party integrations, authentication/authorization functionality, unit/integration/system test cases, automated test scripts, CI/CD pipeline configurations, deployment scripts, Dev/ACC/Production environment documentation, rollback/recovery procedure documentation, deployment checklists and release notes, and API specs/configuration guides.

Mandatory Qualifications


Candidates must demonstrate experience as an A.1 Application/Software Architect, Level 3, and provide two (2) project examples within the last seven (7) years where they successfully performed ALL of the following:
  • API development and integration with database platforms and infrastructure architecture within IM/IT projects
  • Working within an Agile environment (sprint/Design Thinking, collaboration and teamwork)
  • Software development and implementation — specifically SQL, C#, VB.NET; APIs and third-party migrations; Front-End Development (HTML/CSS/JavaScript); Back-End Development (server-side logic, APIs, and database integration); and code quality and technical testing
  • Data management and business intelligence
For each project example, the résumé must clearly identify: (i) the client organization name, (ii) the dates and duration of engagement (month/year start and end), and (iii) a project title and description of the scope of services demonstrating the tasks above.

MRC2 – Education: Candidates must hold a post-secondary degree, diploma, or certificate in IT or Software Engineering from a recognized Canadian institution (per CICIC). A copy of the credential must be provided.
Language: Fluent English (written and oral); must communicate without assistance and with minimal errors.

Technical Environment

VB.NET, C#, Azure SQL Server, Power BI, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), SQL Server SSIS, Azure Data Factory, HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript, ASP.NET, Blazor, RESTful APIs, Entity Framework Core, Azure API Management, JSON, Microsoft DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines), Git/GitHub Advanced Security, Azure (Active Directory, App Service, Functions, Key Vault, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Blob Storage, Entra, Container Registries), Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Model Driven Apps, Power BI, Dataverse), Oracle DB, PostgreSQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft 365.

Requirements

🏗️ Architectural Assistant (Estimating, Bidding & Construction Coordination) – Remote

Full-Time | Remote | EST/CST Hours

🚀 About the Role

We’re hiring a highly organized and detail-oriented Architectural Assistant to support estimating, bidding, project coordination, and documentation workflows for commercial casework and millwork projects.

This is not a basic administrative role.

You’ll play a critical role in:

✅ bid coordination

✅ estimating support

✅ proposal preparation
✅ project tracking
✅ contractor communication

✅ documentation management

You’ll work closely with estimators, contractors, and internal teams to ensure bids are accurate, organized, and submitted on time while maintaining structured project workflows from intake through post-award coordination.

If you thrive in:

  • construction environments
  • estimating workflows
  • architectural coordination
  • documentation-heavy operations
  • deadline-driven project support

this role is a strong fit.

🔥 What You’ll Own

Bid Qualification & Project Organization

  • Review incoming invitations to bid and assess:
    • project scope
    • location
    • fit and relevance
  • Organize project files and documentation inside:
    • Notion
    • Google Drive
    • internal systems
  • Maintain structured, searchable, and accessible records
  • Ensure project information remains accurate and up to date

Estimating & Bid Coordination

  • Coordinate with:
    • internal estimators
    • external estimating partners
    • takeoff specialists
  • Assign projects and track estimating progress
  • Follow up proactively to ensure deadlines are met
  • Clarify scope details and resolve documentation gaps
  • Maintain visibility into:
    • bid timelines
    • deliverables
    • submission status

Proposal Preparation & Bid Submission

  • Review completed estimates for accuracy and completeness
  • Convert estimates into polished proposals using:
    • Microsoft Word
    • PDF formatting tools
  • Submit bids through:
    • Building Connected
    • contractor portals
    • project management systems
  • Ensure all submissions are complete, professional, and on time

Follow-Up & Bid Tracking

  • Follow up with General Contractors regarding:
    • bid status
    • awarded projects
    • lost bid feedback
  • Track:
    • awarded bids
    • rejected bids
    • pending opportunities
  • Maintain organized records of:
    • bid activity
    • contractor communication
    • project outcomes
  • Provide reporting visibility to internal stakeholders

Post-Award Coordination

  • Coordinate project handoff after awarded bids
  • Notify accounting regarding:
    • deposits
    • awarded project details
  • Update internal systems and stakeholders with:
    • project status
    • awarded documentation
    • scheduling updates
  • Maintain clean communication and documentation across teams

💻 Requirements

Core Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in:
    • estimating support
    • project coordination
